messages.subject: PyStan v2.8.0.0 is on PyPI!
messages.body_plain:
PyStan v2.8.0.0 is out now. The new release includes an updated version
of the Stan Math Library.

OS X wheels (2.7, 3.3, 3.4) are also available.

- PyPI: https://pypi.python.org/pypi/pystan
- Documentation: https://pystan.readthedocs.org/
